method: Worlds: `pnpm exec tsx docs/benchmarks/t450/build-worlds.mts 80 .tmp/t450/before 0,1,5,30,60,80` (baseline profile, seed release-century-baseline) and `… 50 .tmp/t450/active 0,30,50 active-management` (seed release-century-active-management), the candidate model from founding as scripts/match-model-baseline.ts founds them; season-N.world.json is the world at the start of season N+1.

Seasons: `pnpm exec tsx docs/benchmarks/t450/time-seasons.mts 3 <worlds…>` plays one more season of each kept world from a fresh parse, three times round-robin after one untimed warm-up, and prints a sha256 of the world after it.

Series: `pnpm exec tsx docs/benchmarks/t450/build-worlds.mts 80 .tmp/t450/series-<side> 30,60,80` plays 80 consecutive baseline seasons in one process, as the benchmark does, and keeps the worlds at seasons 30, 60 and 80.
Fixture: `pnpm exec tsx scripts/match-model-baseline.ts --model candidate --seasons 1 --pilot 1 --out .tmp/t450/mmb-<side>.json` (200 timed fixtures × 3 repetitions after 10 warm-up).
Every step ran alone through `node docs/benchmarks/t450/measure.mjs <side> <step…>`, which samples load1 and the busiest other processes every 30 s.

cuts.note: Each cut is a cache, an index, an early exit or an allocation removed; the same draws in the same order. Shares of the late season saving from the before and after profiles of season 61 (profile-before.json, profile-after.json; shares.cjs): inclusive time of the functions each cut changed. They overlap a little and the profiles carry noise (unattributed below).

list.cut: NPC squads read the people registry once (`peopleOf`) and each club's active players from an index (`playingFor`)
managerial entry reads only people who ever coached (`coachingPeople`); grade and role helpers without allocation; season starts memoized; no coaching job means no service
mentor sync: people who ever coached, clubs by ID, one date per sync

NPC coaching: a day with no ended contract skips the walk, the active coaching index survives other roles' job changes and is built from people who coached; the market reads only people with a coaching profile
aggregate kernel without per-call closures (participation's stoppage decision as methods, team.ts pass completion and carry groups as module functions)
grid tags and coordination without per-call closures; each shape place read once per plan
prepareMatch rates the XIs it chose (`ratingOf`): the XI availability work once per club and fixture
